return { toolAfter: window.__dbg.aeon.state().tool, anyToast: document.body.innerText.match(/[^\n]*(cannot|unavailable|not |use )[^\n]*/i)?.[0] || null, sel: document.querySelectorAll('[aria-selected=true]').length };
